minecraft.quote: I love Minecraft. It's so simple to get hooked into and the 2 week phases are amazing

satisfactory.quote: Satisfactory is literally crack to me, (but legal) you get lost in building production lines that it ends up being 2 hours later than when you last checked the time

rainbow-six-siege.quote: I have a mixed opinion on Rainbow Six Siege. It's fun to play and fun when you win, but sometimes it can take ages. And solo queuing is worse than being hung on the stake

forza-horizon-6.quote: I have yet to get Forza Horizon 6 on PC, but I have played it on Xbox. It is fantastic, however I do feel that Forza Horion games can feel repetitive in the races and in the whole series lineup. Personal opinion, though

forza-horizon-4.quote: Forza Horizon 4 is my favourite game in the Forza Horizon lineup - not biased because its based in England (as am I) but because it is so fun to blast down the fields at high speeds or down the motorway (highway) at 300+ mph

beamng-drive.quote: I don't play BeamNG.drive like Forza Horizon (you can, theres races and campaign and all that) but I play it to just destroy cars and try and crash the game lol, it can be really unstable from time to time as its "in beta" lol

geometry-dash.quote: Geometry Dash is fun, but I'm honestly horrible at it and can't play it for more than 30 minutes without getting bored. The people who make levels are really creative though, so props to them

halo-mcc.quote: I haven't played Halo for long (only a few hours playtime) but the time I did play it was quite fun. I don't have intentions to finish it though or master it, as on Steam theres 700 achievements

escape-the-backrooms.quote: Escape The Backrooms is amazing with friends. The game was really buggy and unstable but it has been ironed out over time, I just wish they did more levels, reworked some levels and made them harder and made it more replayable. Backrooms: Escape Together is similar, but I found it was a bit less fun with friends

backrooms-escape-together.quote: As I said in the Escape the Backrooms quote, this is a fun game but it is less fun than Escape The Backrooms simply due to some levels being way harder and more irritating to do. The procedural generation makes it way more fun to play though, and the level fun and supermarket level were absolutely supreme to play. Me and my friend loved both those 2 levels, but the rest of the game was decent

bloons-td-6.quote: Bloons TD 6 is a great game, I've played more on mobile than PC, but it is fun to play if you are simply bored and want a quick 10 minute game whilst you are waiting for something

roblox.quote: I have a lot of opinions of Roblox. One of them being it used to be genuinely amazing and so fun to play on, but it is becoming really bad and annoying to play now, and its filled with slop games that are made with AI and templates in 5 minutes, and mass copy and pasted. There is some fantastic games on there but a lot of them have had issues and either shutdown, slowed development or had massive reworks. Take Pressure for example - they had a controversy that made their game completely fall apart. Some haven't had these issues and I still play from time to time (town is an example, its fun to play for hours sometimes), but it is becoming increasingly frustrating to play some games on the platform now.

pressure.quote: Pressure is one of my favourite games, ever. I absolutely love it - the atmosphere, the lore, the updates they brought us, the replayability, the challenges and achievements, the voice acting, the individual design for every single room is absolutely phenominal. It's incredible. I am absolutely devasted about the game, and what it may become in the future, because of the drama that happened (I am not going into detail about it. Search it up for yourself if you must) and how every single developer on the old team left, all the voice actors especially, with some saying they are not returning and will never do Roblox VA's again, which broke my heart further. This game is still amazing; I just wish it was how it was before the drama, and every time I think about it.. it honestly makes me tear up. Even writing this, as pathetic as it is, still is making me feel really sad.

town.quote: town is honestly just a fun filler game, what I mean by that is it is good at making you not bored due to the gun fights and base-building aspects of it. I've spent hours and hours (sometimes hundreds of hours) building bases in town and it's really fun every single time

industrialist.quote: Industrialist is a great game. I love it so much. It's similar to Satisfactory in the way you must make factories to produce better items but you do not have to go out and explore instead you sell and make a profit off the items you make. Research is a fantastic addition too, its similar to the Hub in satisfactory, however the recent updates have made research considerably more annoying, bumping it to 4.5 stars. Great game otherwise.

build-a-boat-for-treasure.quote: Build a boat for treasure is honestly fun at times, building is alright but making funny stuff is cool, public servers are insane though, usually there will be 4 afk bots and a huge afk machine down the middle, with mechs destroying the map or lag machines or trolling machines its just a mess which is why I rated it lower

nuclear-blast-testing-facility.quote: Nuclear blast testing facility is a good game. However, it is very pay-gated and I do not like that. You have to pay to get good roles which is honestly a bit insane, it's 3400 robux (~$34) for one role, and that role doesn't give that many good benefits either. Better off spending that elsewhere.

a-core-game.quote: a core game is fantastic. The visuals of the core effect and meltdown and all the events are perfect, the soundtrack is honestly supreme too. Only thing is there isnt much replayability and the whole facility only a small portion is actually functional and utilised where I feel there is so much more potential

cities-skylines.quote: I like Cities Skylines. The modding potential is fantastic and theres a sequel (Cities Skylines 2) but it is not as good. The only thing is I have little to no creativity, and end up repeating boring patterns that make the city end up being a hellhole. Not the game's fault, it is quite a fun game to play from time to time.

planet-coaster.quote: Honestly, I have something to say about this game. I honestly love it - the only thing it was lacking for years was waterparks and water in general, pools all that stuff. Fortunately, Planet Coaster 2 got that, so that's why it has half a star more.

planet-coaster-2.quote: Such a simple game to just play and lose time in it. There's many preset rides and decorations, the editor is fabulous (on pc at least) and it feels so much more fluent than the original planet coaster. Plus, it has waterparks, which the original lacked!!

planet-zoo.quote: I haven't played this game yet. Thus having no opinions on it
